xna-type.name: VertexChannelCollection
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for managing a list of vertex data channels.
xna-type.syntax: public sealed class VertexChannelCollection : IList<VertexChannel>, ICollection<VertexChannel>, IEnumerable<VertexChannel>, IEnumerable

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the number of vertex channels in the collection.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the vertex channel at the specified index position.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the vertex channel with the specified name.

method.name: Add
method.summary: Adds a new vertex channel to the end of the collection.

overload.summary: Adds a new vertex channel to the end of the collection.

parameters.parameter: Name of the new channel.
Initial data for the new channel. If null, the channel is filled with the default value for that type.

overload.summary: Adds a new vertex channel to the end of the collection.

parameters.parameter: Name of the new channel.
Type of data to be contained in the new channel.
Initial data for the new channel. If null, the channel is filled with the default value for that type.

method.name: Clear
method.summary: Removes all vertex channels from the collection.

overload.summary: Removes all vertex channels from the collection.

method.name: Contains
method.summary: Determines whether the collection contains the specified vertex channel.

overload.summary: Determines whether the collection contains the specified vertex channel.

parameters.parameter: Name of the channel being searched for.

overload.returns: true if the channel was found; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Determines whether the collection contains the specified vertex channel.

parameters.parameter: Name of the channel being searched for.

method.name: ConvertChannelContent
method.summary: Converts the channel, at the specified index, to another vector format.

overload.summary: Converts the channel, at the specified index, to another vector format.

type-parameters.type-parameter: Type of the target format. Can be one of the following: Single

parameters.parameter: Index of the channel to be converted.

overload.returns: New channel in the specified format.

overload.summary: Converts the channel, specified by name to another vector format.

type-parameters.type-parameter: Type of the target format. Can be one of the following: Single

parameters.parameter: Name of the channel to be converted.

overload.returns: New channel in the specified format.

method.summary: Gets the vertex channel with the specified index and content type.

overload.summary: Gets the vertex channel with the specified index and content type.

overload.summary: Gets the vertex channel with the specified name and content type.

parameters.parameter: Name of a vertex channel.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Gets an enumerator that iterates through the vertex channels of a collection.

overload.summary: Gets an enumerator that iterates through the vertex channels of a collection.

method.summary: Determines the index of the specified vertex channel.
